_texte.Cine participă în platformă: Who takes part in the platform
_texte.Clienții nu văd identitățile reale ale p: Customers don't see partners' real identities. Partners operate under a pseudonym + unique code.
_texte.Cum funcționează My Darrin · Flux operaț: How My Darrin works · Operational flow
_texte.Cum funcționează My Darrin, pas cu pas:: How My Darrin works, step by step: AI quote, escrow payment, work with a digital warranty.
_texte.De la cererea ta la decontarea parteneri: From your request to partner settlement — everything orchestrated automatically by
_texte.Explorează catalogul de servicii, materi: Explore the catalog of services, materials and equipment. Darrin AI allocates the team automatically.
_texte.My Darrin conectează 10 tipuri de actori: My Darrin connects 10 types of parties — each with a clear role, visibility and a dedicated dashboard.
_texte.Alocarea sarcinilor, suma păstrată ca ga: Task allocation, the amount held as a guarantee (escrow) and payment to the partners after the work is confirmed.
_texte.Suma totală este păstrată ca garanție de: The total amount is held as a guarantee from the moment the order is placed and is released to the partners only once the work is confirmed. Money kept safe for everyone.
_texte.Platforma alocă comanda unui partener el: The platform allocates the order to an eligible partner in the area. If no partner is found, the order goes to the My Darrin team.
_texte.Fiecare actor vede exact ce îl privește: Each participant sees exactly what concerns them in their own dashboard — statuses, escrow, allocations.
_texte.TVA-ul se aplică după țara adresei comen: VAT follows the country of the order address. The minimum order value and the rates are configured per country, in the back office.
_texte.Garanția începe la finalizarea lucrării,: The warranty starts when the work is finished, for the duration set for the service level.
